column1: # CoreCleaner analyzer pins. Parsed ONLY by corecleaner_lib/bootstrap.py; the agent may read it, never edit it.
# teto: isento (registry; one row per pinned target, length is the data). Any edit needs two reviewers (supply-chain wall).
# Grammar: UTF-8, LF, TAB-separated, '#' starts a comment only at line start, blank lines ignored.
# Columns: target  url  sha256  version  bytes
#   url      https URL of the official release asset, file name == dua-v<version>-<target>.(tar.gz|zip)
#   sha256   lowercase hex of the asset, copied from the release API `digest` field (never computed from the download that is being checked)
#   version  dua-cli release the row pins (bootstrap installs exactly this)
#   bytes    asset size, used as the download ceiling and shown at the consent prompt
# Source: gh api repos/Byron/dua-cli/releases/tags/v2.46.0 (2026-10-21); all 6 assets re-downloaded and hashed, sizes and digests match.
